'''Wiley''' was a legendary warrior in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology. He was said to have hunted prey by leaping from tall trees with a rope tied to his foot. "Wiley" was a popular name given to male Ewoks,<ref name="GCG" /> such as a [[Wiley (Ewok)|young Ewok]] from [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="Baby Ewoks">''[[The Baby Ewoks' Picnic Surprise]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The legendary Wiley was first mentioned in the roleplaying game ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'' in [[2003]].<ref name="GCG" />
